title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Desenvolvedor Genexus Pleno
description:
Sobre a Sil Sistemas: nós somos uma empresa de tecnologia que disponibiliza aos nossos clientes um portfólio completo de serviços e soluções em inovação e gestão de negócios. Somos referência nos segmentos de manufatura, agronegócios e transporte de cargas. Nós estamos comprometidos em trabalhar ao lado de nossos clientes para apoiar sua transformação digital e construir juntos um futuro sustentável.

Sobre a vaga Desenvolvedor Genexus - Pleno:

O dia a dia será fazendo o seguinte:   
  • Participar da concepção de todo ciclo de vida de uma nova funcionalidade/produto e ser responsável pela entrega e acompanhamento da mesma;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar as aplicações existentes; detectar e corrigir erros de software em aplicações já existentes;
Requisitos e qualificações:
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações que tornem a vida de nossos clientes mais simples e produtiva;
  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento com Genexus: GX 9, GX 17 e superior;
  • Experiencia em desenvolvimento C# .NET Core;
  • Ampla experiencia com desenvolvimento de RESTful APIs;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git,
  • Conhecimento avançado de bancos de dados relacionais e SQL;
  • Proatividade, organização e boa comunicação.
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência com conteinerização, bem como Docker, Docker-compose;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD;
  • Metodologias ágeis (Kanban/Scrum);
  • Motivação para adquirir conhecimento em novas linguagens e tecnologias. Acreditamos na utilização da melhor ferramenta para solucionar cada desafio, e o constante aprendizado não deve ser uma barreira.
O que Oferecemos:
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e desafiador, onde a inovação é encorajada.
  • Oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • A chance de trabalhar em projetos reais que impactam diretamente os nossos clientes.
  • Mentoria e suporte de profissionais experientes na área.

title: Engineering Manager - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Engineering Team and help spearhead our growth.

As an Engineering Manager, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our Engineering team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Be in charge of the Human Capital for the Project: hiring, retaining, and firing. Compensation plans, motivation, etc.

- Help in the definition and monitor metrics and KPIs for the teams.

- Make sure that team coordination and the development process are executed correctly.

- Lead all the Scrum ceremonies and its compliance.

- Encourage a collaborative engineering culture according to the company values.


Requirements:


- 10+ Experience in Software Development related roles in a relevant company.

- 5+ Experience as a Project Manager or similar.

- Strong Project Management skills.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Advanced English Level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de gestão de projetos, custos e recursos no SAP PS.
  • Atuação como referência técnica e funcional para times multidisciplinares.

Horário: 9h às 18h

Atuação: Remoto

title: Tech Recruiter Sênior - LATAM
description:
Estamos em busca de Tech Recruiter Pleno/Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação na America Latina para clientes internacionais da AI/R Company, grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por conduzir processos seletivos end2end e terá oportunidade de trabalhar com equipes multiculturais.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado para diferentes países da América Latina;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento;
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da marca empregadora na região LATAM .


O que voce precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Vivência com recrutamento internacional (LATAM) e interação com times multiculturais;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Inglês avançado para conversação;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: 3D Generalist
description:
About Zack D. Films

Zack D. Films is a fast-growing 3D animation company producing viral short-form videos for an audience of 40M+. We’re known for engaging, visually compelling viral content and we're looking for talented Contract 3D Generalist Animators to join our team.


Position Overview

As a Contract 3D animator, you will collaborate with our producers to craft captivating 20-45 second 3D clips. These animations are a vital component of our storytelling, adding depth and excitement to our videos. We’re hiring for multiple contract roles and welcome candidates from around the world.


Please review the following videos - if you feel confident that you could create something similar, please apply!



Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with our producers to conceptualize and produce high-quality 3D animations.

Ensure animations meet the creative vision of the channel and are delivered within deadlines.


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a rapidly growing team & one of the most viewed YouTube channels in the world.
  • Work on projects that reach hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.
  • Opportunity for creative freedom, innovation, and growth.
  • Join an online community of animators where you can connect for support, or just to talk shop.
  • Receive guidance and mentorship from our animation lead to help you through your projects.


Compensation

We offer a flat rate per project.


Job requirements:


Proven experience in 3D animation and editing.

Proficiency in character animation, camera work, lookdev, shader effects, and simulations.

Ability to work under deadlines and collaborate effectively with a remote team.

A creative thinker who can independently find unique solutions in their edits.


You MUST complete the Test Project for your application to be considered.

title: Representante de Vendas
description:
About Refer

Refer is an exclusive AI-powered career agent that connects top talent from Stanford, MIT, Harvard, and other top 20 US universities to leading tech companies like NVIDIA, Meta, Glean, DeepMind, Scale AI, and 1,000+ startups.


We are expanding rapidly and launching a Refer & Earn program so more people can help us grow this elite talent community — and get rewarded for it.


✨ About the Role

We’re looking for Sales Representatives who want a flexible, remote opportunity to help talented people find great jobs — and get paid extremely well for it.


This is not a typical “marketing” or “recruiting” job.


Your role is simple:

Share Refer with people who qualify

When they join and get accepted — you earn

If they get hired — you earn big

That's it.


Compensation (Commission Only)

You earn:

  • $50 for every qualified user you bring who signs up
  • $1,000 if they get hired or make a hire through Refer

There is no limit to how much you can earn.

Some ambassadors make a few hundred dollars per week.

Some make thousands.


Who Should Apply

This role is perfect for people who:

  • Are active on LinkedIn
  • Have friends from top universities
  • Know people in tech or startups
  • Are involved in online communities
  • Want a flexible side gig with high upside
  • Want to help people find jobs that match their potential

No experience required.

Just bring people to Refer — we do the rest.


Who Qualifies to Be Referred

You’ll have the most success referring people who are:

  • Job seekers with a degree from a top 20 US university , OR
  • Hiring managers / team leads at top tech companies or startups
  • US-based only

You’ll receive more details and tools after joining.


What You’ll Do

As a Sales Representative, you will:

  • Promote Refer
  • Post about Refer in relevant online communities
  • Invite top talent and hiring managers to join
  • Use your unique invitation link to track earnings
  • Help us grow the strongest talent network in the country

We’ll provide:

  • Messaging templates
  • Guidance on where to promote
  • Best practices to maximize your earnings

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: 360 Consultant (Commercial & Headhunting Background)
description:
We are seeking a highly driven 360 Recruitment Consultant with a strong blend of business development and executive search experience to manage the full recruitment lifecycle from client acquisition to successful candidate placement.

This role is ideal for a professional who thrives in a consultative, performance-driven environment and is comfortable building long-term client relationships while delivering high-quality talent across specialized roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage your own portfolio of clients through consultative business development
  • Lead end-to-end recruitment processes (intake, sourcing, interviews, negotiation, and placement)
  • Execute headhunting strategies for mid to senior-level positions
  • Act as a strategic advisor to clients on hiring needs, market trends, and talent availability
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with both clients and candidates
  • Manage multiple open roles simultaneously with high standards of quality and speed
  • Maintain accurate reporting and pipeline management in CRM/ATS tools
  • Negotiate fees, offers, and employment terms with clients and candidates


Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in 360 recruitment / executive search
  • Proven background in commercial/business development + headhunting
  • Strong experience managing the full recruitment cycle independently
  • Ability to work with senior stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and consultative selling skills
  • High level of autonomy, ownership, and accountability
  • Experience working with specialized or technical roles is a strong plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission structure
  • Highly entrepreneurial environment with strong growth potential
  • Opportunity to build and scale your own client portfolio
  • Exposure to regional and international recruitment projects
  • Direct impact on business growth and strategic hiring initiatives

title: Founding Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Equity Only / Part-Time) – Build a Global Mental Health Platform (US-Based)
description:
To our friends in Brazil: We are specifically recruiting here because the React/Next.js talent is world-class, but often underutilized in local markets. We offer a bridge: Keep your day job, contribute 5-10 hours/week, and earn substantial equity in a US-based C-Corp.


This isn't a job. It's a mission. One billion people are struggling with their mental health. 700,000 preventable deaths each year. Only a fraction ever reach the right provider because borders, languages, and broken marketplaces stand in the way.


Unacceptable. We're fixing it.


Really Global is building the world's first truly global, provider-centric mental health marketplace—so anyone, anywhere, can find the right human in their language, at a price they can afford. We're already live at really.global in 200+ countries. The foundation exists. Now we build the infrastructure that scales.


Next: an AI-powered booking and translation layer with real-time audio translation, making quality care as accessible as ordering dinner. This is a system-level play. When we succeed, access to care becomes normal. Suffering becomes optional.


The Opportunity: Put Your Name on the Blueprint.

This is pure sweat equity for a true builder who's ready to trade the safety of a salary for substantial ownership in a $100M+ platform. You won't be building from scratch—you'll be accelerating what's already moving. Typical commitment: 5-10 hours/week, equity-only, alongside your primary role.


You won't be "feature support." You'll be foundational—your fingerprints on architecture, UX, velocity, and every product decision that helps someone find hope in their darkest moment.


We're backed by founders with a track record of scaling ventures to $130M+ in revenue. This will be the hardest and most meaningful work of your life.


Who You Are (and how you show up)


  • Mission-obsessed. The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.
  • Owner's mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship. Weekly.
  • Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast.
  • Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters.
  • Clear, candid communicator. Crisp async writing; short demos; low-ego reviews.
  • Efficiency and Output Driven: Comfortable leaning hard on tools like Cursor, Claude, or Copilot to move 2x faster, or excited to learn and get there fast.


What You'll Build (and why it matters)

End-to-end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are. Here's what's next:


  • Add recurring calendar availability
  • Publish existing SEO content at scale and optimize the site
  • Roll out the Hotline
  • Complete Talk Now (instant sessions) and Find Matches (survey → ranked suggestions)
  • Add location-based navigation
  • Add site-wide translation and real-time audio translation
  • API/MCP integrations


Our stack: Next.js/React on the front; Python services; Postgres underneath; GitHub, AI-assisted workflows (Cursor/Copilot) to move faster without lowering the bar.


The Deal: Transparent Equity Partnership


  • Merit-based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship.
  • Points-for-outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours. This rewards your efficiency and impact.
  • All work is valued. You earn points not just for new features, but also for essential “glue work” like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response.
  • Real shipped value. Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer (reviewer ≠ author), merged, and live in production. To protect our quality bar, we have a "regression clawback" for code that causes critical bugs.
  • Clear commitment & vesting. We use a 6-month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we're a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3-year period.
  • Quarterly tranches. We calculate and update your accrued share from the dedicated pool each quarter; any unallocated equity rolls forward to the next. This ensures early contributions are fairly rewarded without burning through the pool.
  • High-impact bounties. Mission-critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals.
  • Locked-in stake. When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone's earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table.
  • No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership. All details are codified in a formal, transparent agreement covering vesting, IP, and security.


Why This Will Define Your Career


  • Build Your US Track Record: This is your entry point into the US startup ecosystem. You aren't outsourcing; you are a partner.
  • USD-Denominated Upside: You are trading time now for ownership in a dollar-based asset ($100M+ target valuation).
  • Direct Access: You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No "local office" politics.
  • Human Impact: Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.


Are You the One? If you felt a fire light up reading this—if the scale excites you more than it scares you—we want to hear from you.


This isn't for everyone. But for the right person, this is the opportunity of a lifetime.


To Apply: Send:

  • GitHub (or 1-2 PRs you're proud of) If you can include links to the actual PRs or issues (and a sentence or two of context), even better.
  • A short note: why this mission, and one gnarly problem you've shipped through


If you talk in hours, skip. If you talk in shipped outcomes, welcome.

title: Senior Java Technical Lead (AI-Augmented Development)
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Technical Lead to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, with a strong culture of engineering excellence and innovation.


This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams.


About the Role

As a Senior Java Technical Lead , you will be responsible for leading all technical decision-making across backend and frontend development, ensuring architectural consistency, engineering best practices, and high-quality code delivery.

This role requires an expert-level Java professional who has begun integrating AI-assisted development workflows , including LLMs such as GPT and Claude, into their software engineering practices.


You will lead full-stack developers, collaborate closely with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and AI Engineers, and oversee complex business domains such as Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance .

If you are a seasoned Java engineer who is also evolving into the new era of AI-enhanced software development, this role is for you.


Responsibilities


  • Lead all technical decision-making across backend and frontend architecture.
  • Ensure code quality, engineering best practices, and architectural coherence.
  • Guide full-stack developers implementing backend services and UI components.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, BA, DevOps, and AI Engineer to translate requirements into scalable, secure solutions.
  • Oversee complex financial and operational domains (Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Remittance).
  • Design, supervise, and optimize workflows that leverage LLMs for code generation, review, and refactoring.
  • Provide technical leadership on when and how to use AI tools safely and effectively.


Required Qualifications


Core Engineering Skills:


  • Senior-level Java/Spring Boot experience (expert level required).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and Postgres .
  • Experience with Security, DevOps, Cloud , and GitHub ecosystem.
  • GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.


Cloud & Infrastructure:

  • Strong experience with AWS Identity Management .
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS workloads: EC2, RDS, SQS .


AI & LLM Experience (Required):

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
Job Title: Experienced Anaplan Model Builder (FP&A & Data Integration)

Nice to have skills: FP&A knowledge or certification, Anaplan Data Integration using Anaplan API or other tools.

Role Overview

We are seeking an Experienced Anaplan Model Builder with strong FP&A and data integration experience. The candidate will work closely with the Technical Manager, PDM (Product Development Manager), and directly with business stakeholders to deliver scalable Anaplan solutions and support ongoing operations.

Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance Anaplan models for budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Manager, PDM, and business teams to translate requirements into model designs.
  • Develop modules, dashboards, and UX pages following best practices.
  • Manage data integrations using Anaplan Connect, CloudWorks, Informatica, MuleSoft, etc.
  • Support existing Anaplan applications, including production support, issue resolution, and enhancements.
  • Ensure data accuracy, maintain documentation, and assist with troubleshooting.
  • Support user onboarding, training, and continuous process improvement.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years Anaplan model-building experience; Anaplan Model Builder certification required.
  • Strong FP&A knowledge (budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling).
  • Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP/CRM/data systems.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills for direct business interaction.
  • Nice to have: Java or Python for API integrations with Anaplan; experience with SAP/Oracle/NetSuite/Workday, SQL, or ETL tools.

title: Analista de Operações
description:
Quem somos

Na Artefact LatAm, acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura baseada na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é aquele em que todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Nosso compromisso é construir um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque empatia é para todos, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos mentes e corações incríveis ao nosso lado! Venha ser Artefact!
Sobre a Área
O time de Staffing é o coração operacional da Artefact na América Latina, responsável por garantir que as nossas equipes estejam na configuração certa, no momento certo, para impulsionar o crescimento dos nossos clientes e da própria consultoria.
Somos o elo entre as lideranças, os gerentes de projeto e os times internos, planejando a capacidade operacional, acompanhando a dinâmica de alocação e promovendo uma experiência de excelência para todos os stakeholders, locais e globais.
Nosso dia a dia é intenso e diverso: combina análise, planejamento, relacionamento e inovação. A área está em plena expansão e oferece grande visibilidade dentro da organização, com exposição direta a diretores, sócios e times internacionais.

O que você fará
Como Analista de Operações, você será peça-chave na estruturação e evolução do time de Staffing LATAM.
 Vai atuar lado a lado com lideranças e gerentes de projeto para antecipar necessidades, otimizar o uso da capacidade regional e apoiar decisões estratégicas de alocação de talentos.
Você também terá papel ativo na transformação da área, puxando iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação e padronização de práticas que sustentem o crescimento acelerado da Artefact na região.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de entender o funcionamento da operação da empresa como um todo, desde o planejamento de capacidade até a tomada de decisão estratégica sobre alocações e demandas futuras.

title: GenAI Fullstack Engineer
description:
Job Title: Full Stack Engineer – GenAI Product Development

Duration : Contract

Location : Remote

Department : Engineering / AI Solutions


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to join our dynamic team focused on building custom GenAI products, including workflow automation tools like N8n. This role is ideal for someone passionate about cutting-edge AI technologies and eager to contribute to fast-paced, experimental product development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications with a focus on GenAI integrations.
  • Build scalable frontend interfaces using modern frameworks (e.g., React).
  • Develop robust backend services using Python and Node.js.
  • Integrate with GenAI/LLM platforms such as OpenAI API, LangChain, etc.
  • Architect and implement APIs and microservices for seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across global locations in agile environments.
  • Troubleshoot issues and iterate quickly in a fast-moving development cycle.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven experience in full stack development (frontend + backend).
  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks like React and Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience with GenAI / LLM-based applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of API design, data integration, and microservices architecture.
  • Comfortable working in agile teams and adapting to evolving requirements.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

title: Ionic/Angular Mobile Developer
description:
Role: Ionic/Angular Mobile Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Contract


About Smart IT Frame:

At Smart IT Frame, we connect top talent with leading organizations across the USA. With over a decade of staffing excellence, we specialize in IT, healthcare, and professional roles, empowering both clients and candidates to grow together.


Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain mobile applications using Ionic (Angular-based) with Capacitor and Ionic Components.

• Build and optimize Angular 7+ applications with Typescript and reusable components.

• Apply OOP principles to ensure scalable and maintainable code.

• Collaborate on UI/UX design decisions, ensuring usability and visual appeal.

• Deploy applications to both iOS and Android platforms.

• Integrate applications with REST and/or GraphQL APIs, adapting quickly to new API structures.

• Utilize Git for version control and collaborative development.

• Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders in English (written and verbal).

• Work with new API integrations using C# .Net 8 .


Must Have Skills:

✔ Ionic front-end (Angular-based) with Capacitor and Ionic Components

✔ Angular 7+ with Typescript and components

✔ Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts

✔ CSS, HTML, DOM, Bootstrap

✔ UI/UX design understanding and usability focus

✔ iOS and Android deployment experience

✔ Git repository usage

✔ REST and/or GraphQL API integration

✔ Strong communication skills (English proficiency)

✔ Experience with C# .Net 8 APIs


Recommended Skills (Nice to Have):

• Ability to occasionally support back-end work (Node.js)

• Experience working in small teams and small company environments

• Strong time and complexity estimation skills

• Willingness to assist with DevOps responsibilities when needed.

title: Coordenador Técnico
description:
Responsabilidades

Responsável por coordenar, auditar e alinhar, junto aos assistentes técnicos, os pontos de ação definidos pelo Gerente de Serviços Técnicos. Atua auxiliando na auditoria de todos os processos relacionados à produção de animais para reprodução (matrizes e reprodutores), envolvendo supervisores e o gerente de produção na correção de pontos críticos. Contribui para a capacitação dos colaboradores e formação de novos líderes de setor, além de elaborar o plano de visitas e organizar o atendimento técnico aos clientes. Também é responsável por desenvolver e acompanhar experimentos e testes de campo demandados por clientes ou por outros departamentos da empresa, bem como criar ferramentas para compilação e análise de dados produtivos e reprodutivos de animais DNA em clientes. Coleta informações detalhadas de desempenho a campo e mantém o Gerente de Serviços Técnicos atualizado sobre o andamento das atividades, resultados obtidos e satisfação dos clientes. Realiza visitas técnicas a clientes, parceiros e quarentenárias oficiais, podendo participar dos manejos dos animais quando necessário.


Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em produção animal, preferencialmente com foco em reprodução, nutrição ou manejo de matrizes e reprodutores;
  • Conhecimento em auditoria de processos produtivos e indicadores de desempenho zootécnico;
  • Habilidade para analisar dados técnicos e elaborar relatórios de acompanhamento;
  • Experiência em atendimento técnico a campo e relacionamento com clientes;
  • Boa comunicação, perfil analítico e capacidade de trabalho em equipe;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Carteira de habilitação categoria B ativa.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React.js / Python)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of full-stack experience primarily focused on React.js front-end development. You will join our clients' innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation.

You will participate in the complete software development process from conception to deployment of our clients ' world-class data and insights platform. You will work closely with product and UX leads, providing a critical voice in solutioning complex workflows and user experiences.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, then you are the right person for the job. The ideal candidate must collaborate well within a team, leverage strong technological expertise, and adeptly analyze and prioritize features and requirements. You will build upon our clients' next-generation front-end user experience, connecting it to and enhancing the backend data pipeline.

Our client unleashes the power of culture to drive brand growth through consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 major U.S. brands. Its solutions are powered by its cultural intelligence platform, which enables its customers to understand, reach, and engage consumers more effectively and efficiently, activating them across race, ethnicity, generation, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • Work with development teams and product managers to ideate software solutions
  • Architect and build application front-ends with appealing visual design
  • Develop functional, scalable applications
  • Write effective APIs
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software
  • Create security and data protection settings
  • Build features and applications with a mobile-responsive design
  • Write technical documentation
  • Work with data scientists and analysts to improve AI/ML-based software


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience primarily using React.js in the front-end
  • Knowledge of additional front-end languages and libraries (e.g., HTML / CSS, JavaScript, XML, and jQuery)
  • 2+ years working in AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud platform
  • 1+ years of Python experience
  • Familiarity with databases (e.g., MySQL and MongoDB), web servers (e.g., Apache), and UI/UX design
  • Great attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and an analytical mind
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, statistics, or a relevant field
  • Experience with DataViz
  • Experience with Snowflake, Flask, Django, or FastAPI


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.


Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.


Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work

Oportunidade


Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.


Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.


Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.

  • Pacote de compensações competitivas
  • Ambiente de trabalho estimulante e colaborativo
  • Trabalho remoto

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full-Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities, an aptitude for learning new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, reducing operating costs, saving time, and increasing profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision-support systems once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on Linux, nginx (engine x), fpm, and mostly MySQL
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving

title: Coordenador Técnico Comercial
description:
Responsabilidades

Responsável por coordenar, auditar e alinhar, junto aos analistas técnico-comerciais, técnicos e representantes, as atividades técnicas e de vendas. Colabora com os demais departamentos da empresa, garantindo o correto lançamento de informações nos sistemas internos, além de apoiar na integração e capacitação das equipes técnicas e comerciais. Elabora o plano de visitas e organiza o atendimento técnico-comercial aos clientes, planejando e acompanhando experimentos e testes de campo demandados por clientes ou por outros departamentos. Também é responsável por coletar informações e dados de desempenho de animais DNA em campo, mantendo as gerências técnica e comercial atualizadas quanto ao andamento das atividades, resultados obtidos e satisfação dos clientes. Realiza visitas técnicas a clientes, parceiros e quarentenárias oficiais, podendo envolver-se em manejos dos animais, além de elaborar e ministrar palestras, treinamentos e representar a empresa em eventos.


Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em coordenação ou supervisão de equipes técnicas e comerciais;
  • Conhecimento em nutrição animal, manejo zootécnico e boas práticas de campo;
  • Habilidade para analisar dados técnicos e de desempenho animal;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Carteira de habilitação ativa;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel e PowerPoint)

title: .Net AWS Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior .NET Developer with AWS experience to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Responsibilities :

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
  • Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP.NET, Web APIs, etc.
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
  • Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practices


Requirements:

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • Strong understanding of .NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
  • Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (.NET framework)
  • Hands on experience in AWS environments (Azure is a plus)
  • The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding of AWS features and tools such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
  • Experience supporting an integration and transformation platforms between internal systems and external vendor systems, especially those involving complex business logic.
  • Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
  • Understanding of the QSR (fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
  • Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance,  it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience


Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.
